en: Numbers 24

p.src: 1  When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

ja: バラムは、イスラエルを
することが主の御心にかなうと知り、これまでのように占いを
en: When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
u.src: 1  When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

p.src: 2  Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.

en: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.
u.src: 2  Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.

p.src: 3  He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

en: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

p.src: 4  he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

en: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

p.src: 5  How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!

ja: しいことか、あなたの天幕は。 イスラエルよ、あなたの
en: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!
u.src: 5  How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!

p.src: 6  As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.

ja: えられたアロエのように、
en: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.
u.src: 6  As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.

p.src: 7  Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.

ja: からあふれ、 その種は
en: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.
u.src: 7  Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.

p.src: 8  God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.

en: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.
u.src: 8  God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.

p.src: 9  He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”

ja: す。 雌獅子のように。 だれが
こせよう。 あなたを
en: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”
u.src: 9  He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”

p.src: 10  Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

ja: バラクはバラムに向かって
わせるためにあなたを
en: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.
u.src: 10  Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

p.src: 11  Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, the LORD has kept you back from honor.”

ja: はあなたを大いに厚くもてなすつもりだったが、
がその栄誉をあなたから取り上げられたのだ。」
en: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, the LORD has kept you back from honor.”
u.src: 11  Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, the LORD has kept you back from honor.”

p.src: 12  Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

ja: たちにも、こう申したではありませんか。
en: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

p.src: 13  ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the LORD’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what the LORD says’?

ja: うことはできない。私は
en: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the LORD’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what the LORD says’?

p.src: 14  Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

ja: ります。しかしその前に、後の日にこの
en: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

p.src: 17  I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.

ja: くではない。 ヤコブから一つの星が進み出て、 イスラエルから一つの王笏が立ち上がる。 それはモアブのこめかみを
き、 シェトの子らをことごとく打ち倒す。
en: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.

p.src: 18  Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

ja: となる。 イスラエルは力を現す。
en: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.
u.src: 18  Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

p.src: 19  Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”

en: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”

p.src: 20  He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”

ja: 々の初め。 しかし、その
en: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”
u.src: 20  He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”

p.src: 21  He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.

en: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.

ja: しかし、カインは焼き尽くされる。 ついにはアッシュルがおまえを
en: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”
u.src: 22  Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”

p.src: 23  He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?
